tools.name: about_global_connect_show
tools.description: What GCS is, who it is for (brands building international trust and media visibility), and the main links.

tools.name: get_upcoming_events
tools.description: Upcoming Global Connect Show and GCSx events: dates, cities, venues and event pages.

tools.name: get_newsletter_info
tools.description: What the free GCS newsletter contains, how often it is sent, recent issues, and the accepted roles and interests.

tools.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
tools.description: Sign your user up for the free Global Connect Show newsletter. Only for people who asked for it or agreed. GCS emails them a confirmation link; nothing is sent until they click it. Roles: media, creator, judge, distributor, investor, brand, analyst, association, other (marketing/brand people: brand)

tools.name: get_registration_form
tools.description: Fields, roles, options (goals, events, coverage topics) and an example for one of the GCS website forms: "register" (Register for GCS: brands, investors, experts, distributors, associations) or "media-registration" (journalists and content creators).

tools.name: register_for_gcs
tools.description: Fill in Register for GCS for your user (brands, investors, judges/experts, distributors, analysts, associations). Same fields as the web form; see get_registration_form. Needs consent: true. GCS emails them a confirmation link; it goes through when they click it, then the GCS team follows up.

tools.name: register_as_media
tools.description: Fill in Media registration for a journalist or content creator (GCS media invitations and news). Same fields as the web form; see get_registration_form. Needs consent: true. They confirm by email; the media team then checks credentials.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_as_media" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_newsletter_info · Private data: register_as_media · Public sink: register_as_media.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_newsletter_info · Private data: register_as_media · Public sink: register_as_media

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
